# Kalmate
> Free Bloomberg-style financial terminal with real-time market data.

https://kalmate.app

## About
Kalmate is a free financial terminal that provides real-time market data for equities, forex, bonds, commodities, and crypto. Features include portfolio tracking, price alerts, a stock screener, TradingView-powered charts, and financial news.

## Key pages
- Landing page: https://kalmate.app/
- Console: https://kalmate.app/console
- Documentation: https://kalmate.app/console/stock/AAPL

## Features
- Market Dashboard: Real-time quotes for 6 market categories
- Portfolio Tracking: Track holdings with real-time P&L
- Smart Alerts: Price alerts with browser notifications
- Stock Screener: Filter and sort thousands of instruments
- Professional Charts: TradingView-powered with 1d-1y ranges
- Financial News: Integrated news feed per instrument

## Tech
Built with Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TradingView Lightweight Charts, Yahoo Finance API, Cloudflare Pages.
